findings.evidence: After the exact core read, the run scans project files and executes git status. The latter fails with exit 128. The request needs only a portable text draft and supplied facts.
findings.impact: Unnecessary read-only operations add work and a failed check without improving the requested draft.
findings.repair: Make response-only creation use sufficient supplied context directly. Separate any required host instruction-file discovery from unnecessary project or Git inspection.
findings.retest: On the same normal request, record only the necessary candidate load and no unsupported repository/Git checks.
